title: Check Your Work
goal: Did it really work? Click. Test. Try again. THEN say done.
mascot_lines: Even great code can have tiny bugs hiding inside.
So before we say we're done, we read the code carefully and run it.
Tests are little experiments that prove our code does the right thing.
Checking your work feels slow at first, but it saves you from way more trouble later.

tier2.rephrase: You make it, you try it, you see if it broke, THEN you say done.

tier3.nudge: The last step is bragging. Before that you must test it!
